units.source_text: 源氏表面上装作若无其事，然而难免露出不快之色。

en.t: Genji outwardly pretended that nothing was wrong, but he could not help showing a look of displeasure.

units.source_text: 紫夫人以为他怜我久病新愈，所以回来看视，其实真心疼爱三公主，时时在挂念她吧。

en.t: Lady Murasaki thought that he had come back to see her out of pity because she had only just recovered from a long illness, but in truth he must dearly love the Third Princess and be thinking of her constantly.

units.source_text: 便对他说道：“我的病已经好了。

en.t: So she said to him, "My illness is already better.

units.source_text: 听说三公主身体还很不适，你这样早就回来，岂不委屈了她？”

en.t: I hear that the Third Princess is still quite unwell; if you came back so soon, would that not be unfair to her?"

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“是呀，她身体不适，但也并无大病，故我可以放心。

en.t: Genji answered, "Yes, she is unwell, but it is not a serious illness, so I can be at ease.

units.source_text: 皇上屡次遣使来问病，听说今天也有信来呢。

en.t: His Majesty has repeatedly sent messengers to ask after her illness, and I hear that a letter came today as well.

units.source_text: 朱雀院曾经郑重嘱咐皇上，所以皇上如此关念她。

en.t: The Suzaku Retired Emperor once earnestly entrusted her to His Majesty, and that is why His Majesty is so concerned about her.

units.source_text: 我待她倘略有疏慢，朱雀院和皇上都要挂念，我很对不起他们。”

en.t: If I were even slightly negligent toward her, both the Suzaku Retired Emperor and His Majesty would worry, and I would feel deeply sorry toward them."

units.source_text: 说罢叹息一声。

en.t: After saying this, he gave a sigh.

units.source_text: 紫夫人说：“皇上挂念，还在其次；

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "His Majesty's concern is still a secondary matter;

units.source_text: 公主本人心中怀恨，倒是对她不起的。

en.t: if the princess herself harbors resentment in her heart, that would truly be doing her a wrong.

units.source_text: 即使公主自己不怪怨你，亦必有侍女在她面前说你短长。

en.t: Even if the princess herself does not blame you, there will surely be ladies-in-waiting who speak of your faults in front of her.

units.source_text: 这倒是很可担心的。”

en.t: That is what is truly worrying."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“实在，对于我所深爱的你，她是一个累赘。

en.t: Genji said, "In truth, for you whom I love so deeply, she is a burden.

units.source_text: 你却替她考虑得如此周到，这样那样，连一般侍女们的用心也都关念到。

en.t: And yet you think so carefully on her behalf, considering this and that, even taking into account the feelings of the ordinary ladies-in-waiting.

units.source_text: 而我呢，只知道顾虑皇上圣心不乐。

en.t: As for me, I only know how to worry that His Majesty's august heart might be displeased.

units.source_text: 我对她的爱情太浅薄了。”

en.t: My love for her is far too shallow."

units.source_text: 他微笑着说，借以掩饰他的心事。

en.t: He said this with a smile, using it to conceal what was truly on his mind.

units.source_text: 谈起回六条院的事，源氏屡次说：“我们一同回去，舒舒泰泰地过日子吧。”

en.t: Whenever the matter of returning to Rokujo-in came up, Genji repeatedly said, "Let us go back together and live our days in comfort and peace."

units.source_text: 但紫夫人总是答道：“让我暂时在这里静养吧。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki always replied, "Let me rest quietly here for a while.

units.source_text: 你先回去，等公主身体好了，我就迁回。”

en.t: You go back first, and when the princess has recovered, I will move back too."

units.source_text: 如此谈谈说说，不觉过了数日。

en.t: In this way, as they talked back and forth, several days passed before they knew it.
